title: Show a recorded evaluator receipt in the public result after a transport failure
outcome: When a recorded evaluator submission is followed by a genuine child transport failure, the public result leads with the receipt-derived outcome and retains the transport diagnostic without presenting child prose as the evaluation verdict.
acceptance: A recorded evaluator submission followed by Error without a latest result packet exposes the recorded receipt outcome in the public DelegationResult, with the transport failure retained as diagnostic metadata or a note.
The same receipt-first behavior holds when an Active or Stopping child has no runtime and no result packet; genuine transport failures without a recorded submission remain distinguishable.
Behavioral tests cover these cases without replacing or rewriting the stored receipt, open write, evaluation, or verification records.
